messages:
sara: Heads-up — plan to start the v2 API cutover tomorrow 02:00 UTC. 2-hour quiet window. Will do: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100, telemetry gates + mobile SDK pinlist. Please call hold if any client pins or probe spikes. :eyes:

deploybot: Scheduled deployment: 
- service: api-gateway
- image: ghcr.redwood/api:release-v2.3.0
- rollout-id: rb-6200000000
- canary: 5% starting 02:10 UTC
- preflight: smoke + integration tests passed on staging at 2026-03-20T18:12Z

juan: Quick q — what's our rollback trigger threshold? specifically mobile SDK 4xx/5xx behavior we care about?

kevin: Rollback/hold thresholds we agreed on in ops playbook:
- global 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 5m -> pause and evaluate
- mobile SDK error rate delta > 2x baseline for 10m -> hold
- canary token latency P95 > 2x baseline for 3m -> hold
Link to pinlist & release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.3.0/notes (updated)

mira: There's a small schema tweak for the `client_meta` header (added `region_hint`). It's backward compatible but mobile SDK older than 1.8 won't send it. Flagging in release notes.

alex: Canary plan — do we want to include regional staging first (EU only) or global 5%? EU traffic has most mobile customers. Suggest EU-only 5% for first step.

sara: Good call — switch first canary to EU-only 5%, then global 25. Update deploybot?

deploybot: Updated rollout config: canary-step-1 region=eu, pct=5; step-2 global pct=25; step-3 global pct=100. Canary telemetry hooks enabled.

ops-runner: Ops on-call here. We'll watch mobile probes and gateway 5xx. If mobile SDK error delta >2x or EU 5xx >1% sustained 5m, we'll hit the operator hold and pin the v2 header off. 

support-bot: Notifying support channel and on-call docs updated: /channels/support and /pager/duty-team. Auto-message scheduled at 01:50 UTC.

--- (deployment window) ---

deploybot: Canary step 1 started (EU 5%): rollout-id rb-6200000000-step1

ops-runner: Seeing a small spike in EU mobile 4xx from one client app version (android-1.5.2). Investigating.

kevin: Which errors? stack traces? might be client-side schema handling.

ops-runner: Logs show repeated 400 with body: `{"error":"invalid_client_meta"}` coming from mobile-1.5.2 users. Not widespread but concentrated in one tenant.

mira: That matches the `region_hint` change — older SDK treats extra field as validation failure in the thin client layer. Need a server-side tolerant parse for the header for a hotfix.

juan: Can we hotpatch gateway to ignore unknown client_meta fields? Quick toggle?

alex: We have a feature flag `strict_client_meta` in gateway config. Default off in prod but apparently set to on for some edge deployments. Ops — can you flip it?

ops-runner: Flipped `strict_client_meta` -> false for eu-edge cluster at 02:22 UTC. Monitoring.

ops-runner: Error rate dropped ~70% in affected tenant within 90s. EU 4xx back to baseline.

sara: Excellent. Given the quick mitigation, do we continue canary progression or hold to validate across more tenants?

mira: I'd hold one more canary window (15m) to ensure older SDKs clear. Also push a note to mobile SDK team to publish a minor patch tomorrow.

kevin: Agreed. Recommendation: pause progression to step 2, keep EU 5% for another 15m, then proceed if stable. If we see any new mobile SDK delta > 1.5x, we abort and pin back to v1 route.

deploybot: Canary progression paused by operator (ops-runner). rb-6200000000 status: paused at step1 by ops-runner at 02:29 UTC.

support-bot: Support update sent: "v2 rollout paused during EU canary — temporary regressions for older Android SDK versions mitigated; monitoring ongoing."

juan: For record — rollback plan if it re-escalates: 1) operator pin header -> route traffic back to v1 2) rollback gateway image to prev stable 3) emergency hotfix branch for tolerant parsing 4) follow-up release notes + customer comms.

sara: Sounds good. Please create the rollback runbook snippet in the release page and tag oncall. I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for those tenants.

kevin: I added the runbook snippet and pinned the hotfix PR link: https://gh.redwood/pulls/8371 (hotfix: tolerant-client-meta).

mira: Also opened mobile SDK issue for patching downstream: https://gh.redwood/issues/4492

ops-runner: We'll unpause only after 15m stable window. If stable, we'll move to global 25% at 02:45 UTC. If not, we'll execute rollback sequence.

sara: Thanks everyone. Postmortem scheduled for 10:00 UTC tomorrow to capture why strict flag was mis-set in EU edge.

deploybot: When resumed, deploybot will post updates. For now: paused and monitoring. rb-6200000000 paused. :white_check_mark:
